column3: Re-derives proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB12.v (the image B descriptor) with atable.py from the image B pin, twin_syms.B.tsv (re-extracted from the twin when it is given), the donor image B and the donor's released proofs/cgif/cgif_file_fuzzer/lib/YB12.v. The header input (the 7-line provenance comment the tool writes verbatim) is taken from lines 1-7 of the shipped YB12.v, which are byte-equal to it; it is not shipped as a file because its last line names a work lane. Compares the output byte for byte with commit 7bae547bef80's YB12.v (the tool's recorded output, when a repository is given) and with the shipped YB12.v after undoing its one hand edit.

The image-descriptor generator: writes YB12.v (image range and PT_LOAD fields from the program headers, code addresses as symbol + offset, the sealed-string address, the 12 stops_more sites, TFIB_TEXT_LO = e_entry and TFIB_TEXT_N = the donor's released text end relocated into image B, over 4). New version of the frozen atable.py b9aa677211b7 (commit 7c290da912ec, tools/startup/frozen/atable.py.frozen-b9aa677211b7): it reads the twin's symbols from twin_syms.B.tsv instead of the twin ELF (the twin check moves to extract_twin_syms.py; this script checks the image sha256 that the extract names), and one docstring line drops a branch name; no other change. Its output and its --fields table are byte-equal to the frozen version's. Python standard library only; it imports no other start-up tool. Its output equals commit 7bae547bef80's YB12.v. The shipped YB12.v differs from it in one hand edit (commit a34e82e078a1): TFIB_TEXT_N 112697 -> 112841, plus header line 8 that records it. The tool gives 112697 ((0x9f008 - 0x30f24) / 4, the donor end 0x9ca00 relocated to 0x9f008); the shipped 112841 is image B's own .text size / 4 ((0x9f248 - 0x30f24) / 4), set by hand. The later atable version 1ce98fbad397 adds a 13th stops_more entry 0x6ed18 (SealedRepairReservation + 0xc0) that the shipped file does not have; the shipped file keeps the 12 entries, so that run is not shipped.

Writes twin_syms.B.tsv: the STT_FUNC symbols (name, start, size) that atable.py looks up (its CODE_SPEC and STOP_SPEC names), read from the unstripped twin of the image B pin with atable.py's own ELF reader. Refuses unless PT_LOAD 2..4 of twin and pin are byte-equal and all PT_LOAD bytes agree with the ELF header and build-id note masked (the twin check the frozen atable.py made). Its header names the twin's and the pin's sha256.

Symbol extract of the unstripped twin of fuzz_disco.asan-ubsan (twin sha256 ead714913acd, pin sha256 cee6f04ad3d4, PT_LOAD 2..4 byte-equal): the 20 STT_FUNC symbols atable.py looks up for YB12.v. The twin is a host binary and is not shipped; run.sh re-extracts this file byte for byte when the twin is given.
